name: add_to_list
description: Add (or with remove:true, remove) a component/theme/template to one of the caller's bookmark lists. Idempotent; adding also ensures the item is bookmarked. Use the list id from list_bookmark_lists and the item id+type from a search result.

id.description: The item id (component demo id / theme uuid / template id). A numeric id may be passed as text.

remove.description: Set true to remove the item from the list.

type.description: What kind of item the id refers to.
